title: Workflows, agents and who owns the control flow

items.stem: Both a workflow and an agent can call a language model several times and use tools. What is the difference between them?

options.text: A workflow uses one model call and an agent uses many model calls
In a workflow the code sets the path; in an agent the model does
A workflow cannot call tools, while an agent is the one that can
In a workflow the user sets the path; in an agent the code does

items.stem: A makerspace assistant first asks the model to label each student message as 'manual question', 'booking' or 'other'. The program then sends the message down one of three fixed code paths based on that label. Which description fits this system best?

options.text: An agent, because a model call chooses the label for each message
An agent, because it handles three kinds of request, not one
Neither, because a system that uses a model is always an agent
A workflow, because the code decides which path each message takes

items.stem: Every booking request in your makerspace assistant needs the same three steps in the same order: read the requested time, check the calendar, then book or suggest another slot. Your sponsor gave you a small model budget. What is the best design for this part?

options.text: A fixed workflow, because the steps are known and it avoids wasted model calls
An agent, because the model can then choose its own steps for each request
An agent, because an agent is always cheaper than a workflow in the end
A fixed workflow, because a workflow can handle any request without changes

items.stem: Booking requests run as a fixed workflow that always makes exactly 2 model calls per request. A team member proposes an agent version that would make 5 model calls per request on average. Over 200 booking requests, how many more model calls would the agent version make than the workflow?
In one sentence, what must be true about a task for an agent to be a better choice than a fixed workflow?
Which part of the makerspace assistant is the strongest candidate to be an agent rather than a fixed workflow?

options.text: Sending a confirmation message after a booking has been made
Looking up a student's training status before a booking is made
Answering a vague question that may need an unknown number of manual searches
Turning 'tomorrow at 3' into a date and time for the calendar tool
